landing.heading: మెరుగైన వ్యవసాయ నిర్ణయాలు.
landing.description: Hyper-local weather advisories, Soil Health Card analysis, agricultural input verification, and multilingual AI voice assistance in one accessible farmer platform.
landing.featuresDescription: Access core agricultural services powered by AgriVoice Pillar APIs and voice assistance.
landing.weatherDescription: Monitor real-time field conditions, 7-day and 48-hour forecasts, extreme weather alerts, and stage-aware crop advisories.
landing.soilDescription: Import Soil Health Cards, review NPK and micronutrient ratings, check fertilizer dosages, and verify seeds or fertilizers.
landing.voiceDescription: Ask questions by voice or text in your regional language to get grounded weather, soil, and input guidance.
landing.loginDescription: Sign in with your registered mobile number and OTP to connect your farms, weather forecasts, soil reports, and voice tools.

auth.title: రైతు లాగిన్
auth.subtitle: Authenticate with your registered mobile number to access your farm weather, soil health cards, and voice tools.
auth.otpHint: Enter the 6-digit one-time password sent to your phone.
auth.otpSentMessage: OTP verification challenge created. Enter your 6-digit code.
auth.invalidPhone: Enter a valid 10-digit Indian mobile number or E.164 phone number.
auth.demoSectionDescription: If the authentication service is not running locally yet, use Demo Farmer Mode to inspect the dashboard, weather, soil, and voice workflows.
auth.tokenSectionToggle: Have a Backend Dev JWT Token?
auth.tokenPlaceholder: Paste JWT issued by Fastify backend...
auth.backendAuthNotice: Live OTP endpoints were not detected on this server; you can use Demo Farmer Mode or connect with a valid backend JWT.

dashboard.subtitle: All your farm weather, soil health, crop advisories, and voice tools in one place.
dashboard.signInPromptDesc: Sign in with OTP or activate Demo Farmer Mode to load farm telemetry.

weather.title: వాతావరణం & పంట సలహా
weather.subtitle: Live micro-climate conditions, daily & hourly forecasts, active alerts, and crop-stage advisories.
weather.noAlerts: No active weather alerts for your farms right now.
weather.noAdvisories: No advisories found for this filter.

soil.title: నేల ఆరోగ్యం & ఇన్‌పుట్ నిర్ధారణ
soil.subtitle: Lookup Soil Health Cards, track nutrient balance, review fertilizer dosages, and verify agricultural inputs.
soil.lookupDesc: Import a Soil Health Card from the national registry or test using demo mode.
soil.noReports: No soil health reports linked yet. Use Card Lookup to import one.
soil.inputVerifyDesc: Verify fertilizers, seeds, pesticides, or bio-stimulants before application.
soil.demoDisclaimer: Demo mode uses synthetic fixtures only and does not make official regulatory claims.
soil.notFoundAdvice: No matching registry record found. This does not prove counterfeit; confirm with your local Mandal Agriculture Officer.

voice.title: ఏఐ వాయిస్ సహాయం
voice.subtitle: Speak or type in your preferred language to query weather, soil context, alerts, and input verification.
voice.assistantGreeting: Ask AgriVoice about today's farm weather, your Soil Health Card, active alerts, or product verification.
voice.inputPlaceholder: Ask a question or speak using the microphone...
voice.micUnsupported: Browser microphone recognition is unavailable here. Type your question or tap a quick prompt below.
voice.promptWeather: What is today's weather and forecast for my farm?
voice.promptSoil: Summarize my latest Soil Health Card and deficiencies
voice.promptAlerts: Are there any active weather alerts for my farm?
voice.helplineDesc: Farmers without smartphones can dial the toll-free AgriVoice number to connect through Exotel telephony.
voice.groundingNote: Responses strictly use verified API measurements and never fabricate missing nutrient or forecast values.
